name: awesome-albert-plugins
description: Lint, type-check, test and package the Albert python plugins in this repo.

init_hook: # The python tooling (ruff, mypy, pytest, pre-commit) lives in the repo's
# own .venv, which every justfile recipe drives. Build it once on first
# entry; later entries reuse it. `just install-tools` is the single source
# of truth for what goes in, so there is no second list here. Every task
# itself is a `just` recipe, never a devbox script.
if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python -m venv .venv && just install-tools; fi
